notes.title: Update Jump Improvement
notes.notes:

notes.title: PixelGround Large Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41655544/fe93df216bf6e1892b313729b46068cbcc59f0bd.png[/img]
A large update is made in the SoloPlay mode.

Survival mode
Loglike rules are applied to combat various AIs alone.

1 VS 1 mode
You can fight AI alone.

Soccer mode 
It is equipped with AI, so you can play as a team by yourself.

UI Reorganization
Gameplay UI has been reorganized more neatly.
